implementation_revision_notes: rev1: initial plan package (manifest, Scrapling FetcherSession runner, extractors, 22-column CSV, diagnostics, README, unit tests).
rev2: smoke run passed for fields, but a unit test found ambiguous '1,234' was accepted as 1234; parser now rejects a lone separator with three digits. No live field bug.
rev3: fix task v2 added evidence-based 02 tax_basis extraction from the public variant taxable flag (v1 used a constant placeholder).

build_errors.fix: reject a lone separator followed by exactly three digits; covered by test_contract.py

build_errors.error: PyYAML is not installed in the fixed environment and packages may not be installed
build_errors.fix: manifest was hand-checked line by line; no YAML parser validation was recorded

limitations: Bounded 30-product run; the product sitemap declared 707 product URLs, so this is not full-site coverage.
All 30 sampled products were single-variant; live option extraction was not exercised, only unit-tested with fixtures.
All 30 sampled products had a complete embedded description; partial/fallback/not-provided/failed statuses were not exercised by live data.

No zero-price or missing-price product appeared in the first 30; the zero-price branch was live-verified by a build diagnostic on java-jacket-drink-sleeves-8-24-oz-copy (excluded, not in valid.csv). Missing-price and invalid-amount branches remain unit-tested only.
No HTTP 429 occurred in any run; 429 Retry-After handling is implemented but not live-verified.
Product pages omit a tax-inclusive/exclusive statement; tax_basis uses the public variant taxable flag only.

All 30 sampled products had Product JSON-LD; the no-JSON-LD fallback was live-verified by the same zero-price build diagnostic (og_price_currency, h1 name, embedded vendor), but that product is outside valid.csv.
Static HTML only; JS-only tabs and widgets were not rendered or exercised.
Proxy environment variables HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY are present; values were not recorded and egress was not independently measured.
The manifest YAML was not machine-parsed because no YAML parser is installed in the fixed environment.

fix_task.change: Added evidence-based 02 tax_basis extraction from embedded variants[*].taxable. v1 wrote a constant unknown_not_stated; v2 writes no_tax_applied when all variants are non-taxable, mixed_taxability for mixed flags, and keeps unknown_not_stated when the flag is true or absent.
fix_task.note: The same 30 product URLs were used; no samples were removed or added to pass the fix.

difference_from_fix_rerun.note: Same plan version and same 30 product URLs; no business value changed.

resources.note: One in-process curl_cffi session per run, closed by the FetcherSession context manager; no browser was started.

network.note: Not an independent egress measurement; proxy values are not recorded.
